Category: Product Analytics + Session Replay + Feature Flags
Best_For: Solo founders who want all-in-one free analytics with privacy. Best for Stage 2-4.
Anti_Pattern: Don't add PostHog + Mixpanel + GA4 together — pick ONE. PostHog does everything at Stage 2-4.
Giantiny_Note: 1 tool = Giantiny ③. PostHog is the default recommendation for EaseStart.

Best_For: Teams who need deeper analytics with clean UI. Better for mobile + B2C.
Anti_Pattern: Don't use Mixpanel free tier for serious analysis — event limits are generous but advanced features are paid.
Giantiny_Note: Free tier is very generous. Good option if PostHog feels too complex.

Best_For: Mid-stage startups (100K+ users) who need predictive analytics and behavioral cohorts.
Anti_Pattern: Don't use Amplitude before Stage 4 — features designed for scale problems you don't have yet.
Giantiny_Note: Overkill for Stage 2-3. Only consider at Stage 4+ with 10K+ users.

Best_For: Websites needing basic traffic analytics. Required for SEO/SEM tracking.
Anti_Pattern: Don't use GA4 as your ONLY product analytics — it's great for traffic but weak for product behavior.
Giantiny_Note: GA4 for traffic + PostHog for product. 2 tools max.

Key_Features: Pageviews|Referrers|Countries|Goals|UTM tracking. No cookies. GDPR compliant.
Best_For: Privacy-focused founders who want simple page-level analytics without cookie banners.
Anti_Pattern: Don't use Plausible as product analytics — it only tracks page-level events. Pair with PostHog for product events.
Giantiny_Note: Simple + cheap + privacy. Good pairing: Plausible (traffic) + PostHog (product).

Best_For: Understanding WHERE users get confused. Visual debugging of UX problems.
Anti_Pattern: Don't watch 100 sessions without a hypothesis — watch 10 sessions of users who DROPPED OFF at a specific funnel step.
Giantiny_Note: PostHog already includes session replay. Only add Hotjar if you specifically need surveys.

Key_Features: Event routing|Identity resolution|Data warehouse sync|300+ integrations
Best_For: Late-stage startups (Stage 5+) with 3+ analytics tools that need unified data pipeline.
Anti_Pattern: Don't add Segment before 1000 MAU — it adds complexity without value at low volume. This is the #1 premature analytics infra anti-pattern.
Giantiny_Note: Segment at Stage 2 = over-engineering. Only when you need 3+ tool integrations.

Best_For: Founders who want the simplest possible analytics. One-line install. Zero config.
Anti_Pattern: Don't use as product analytics — web traffic only.
Giantiny_Note: Simpler than Plausible. Good for landing pages and Stage 0-1 validation.
